checks.claim: PACTA-v1 remains a separate invalid/unqualified interface execution; its 6 Pilot states, 13 sealed states, and 18 partial policy responses are excluded from v1.1 effect analysis.
PACTA-v1.1 changed only deterministic ACTION SCHEMA extraction; P0/P1, the Gate, canonicalization, arms, models, rollouts, and thresholds remained frozen.
The non-scientific schema qualification passed 40/40 exact outputs with zero model drift and zero thinking fallback.
The seven Pilot states were outcome-blind hash minima, one from each of seven untouched templates: 353, 238, 272, 653, 440, 792, and 264.
The original inherited current_state response-envelope failure was repaired: all 28 scientific projections had exactly the top-level fields action and next_goal, and none had current_state.
Strict scientific projection realization was 27/28 because task 238 success/P0 emitted two actions; policy execution therefore stopped before SCB or policy calls.
The observed strict Gate geometry was 0/7 open and 7/7 closed; this is a non-qualifying degenerate geometry, not evidence of a PACTA mechanism effect.
No U, A3-minus-A2, A3-minus-A1, A2-minus-A1, or A2-minus-A0 estimate is authorized.
No same-substrate confirmatory or terminal evaluation was executed.
PACTA-v1.1 is not qualified, is not a negative mechanism result, creates no R10, and R9 remains the active manuscript.
